scope: Runtime review after introducing the FM 2026 design adapters for match, transfer, team and training surfaces. Active manual telemetry remains separated; the UI adapters preserve classic-DOM fallbacks and one read-only storage migration key remains.

classificationDefinitions.ACTIVE: Directly used by the current production workflow.
classificationDefinitions.ACTIVE_BUT_MISNAMED: Active code stored under a historical or misleading namespace.
classificationDefinitions.MIXED_ACTIVE_LEGACY: Active module containing legacy or compatibility candidates that require symbol-level extraction before deletion.
classificationDefinitions.LEGACY_CANDIDATE: Potentially obsolete symbol or state; static and runtime evidence is still required before removal.
classificationDefinitions.REVIEW_REQUIRED: The automated audit found insufficient positive reachability evidence. Inclusion in the bundle is not deletion evidence; side effects and runtime patching must be inspected.
classificationDefinitions.MIGRATION_ONLY: Read-only compatibility retained solely to migrate persisted data from a published predecessor.
